description: Archived still frames for a resort's webcams (or one cam) over the last 1–48 hours, as links with capture times, plus the newest storm frame on tape per cam. Only cams whose operator allows archiving appear; PeakCam captures every 6 hours. Use it for "what did it look like this morning" or "show me the last storm". Frames are never returned inline.

camId.description: Optional: one cam's id from get_resort_cams; default is every archived cam at the resort.

slug.description: PeakCam resort slug, lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `breckenridge` or `ski-portillo`. Get it from search_resorts.

keeper.description: True when captured during a storm (≥ 6 in in 24 h); kept a year instead of 30 days.
